component.name: SurfCraft
component.summary: Surfboard design: outline, rocker, rails, volume and printable templates

description.p: SurfCraft is a surfboard design program. Shape the outline, rocker and cross-sections with Bezier curves, see volume and weight update live, compare against other boards, print full-size templates and export 3D models and machine toolpaths.
Runs on macOS, Windows and Linux, and opens and saves BoardCAD .brd files.
